title: 垂直 NAND 記憶體堆疊
summary: 從垂直字串、階梯接點到良率地圖：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Vertical strings and Staircase contacts to Yield map: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 垂直字串 → 晶圓彎曲
stages.description: 把「垂直字串」「交替薄膜」「晶圓彎曲」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Vertical strings, Alternating films, Wafer bow.

steps.title: 垂直字串：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell.
steps.instruction:
畫穿過多層字線的通道並標示選擇閘和每層記憶單元。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設一條 NAND 串有 64 個可儲存單元，每單元用 TLC 編碼 3 bit，原始容量為 64×3=192 bit。另有兩個選擇閘，不能計入儲存單元數；若編碼改為每單元 2 bit，則為 128 bit。未扣 ECC、備援與壞單元，也不由此推算整顆晶片密度。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw a channel through stacked wordlines with select gates and per-layer cells. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume one NAND string has 64 storage cells, each encoded as TLC with 3 bits: raw capacity is 64×3=192 bits. Two additional select gates are not storage cells. At 2 bits per cell the string has 128 raw bits. ECC, redundancy and bad cells are not deducted, and this does not determine whole-chip density.
steps.observation: 堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數；選擇閘與儲存單元的功能不同。
steps.observationEn: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell; Select gates differ from storage cells.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating stack layers with bits per cell", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「垂直字串」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數。
算例驗收：圖上分開 64 個儲存單元與兩個選擇閘，驗算 192 與 128 bit，說明層數與每單元位元數不同。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Vertical strings diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell.
Worked-example acceptance: Separate 64 storage cells from two select gates; verify 192 and 128 bits and distinguish layer count from bits per cell.

knowledge.title: 垂直字串／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell.

knowledge.title: 垂直字串／驗證與限制
knowledge.text:
模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」。
假設數值與推算：假設一條 NAND 串有 64 個可儲存單元，每單元用 TLC 編碼 3 bit，原始容量為 64×3=192 bit。另有兩個選擇閘，不能計入儲存單元數；若編碼改為每單元 2 bit，則為 128 bit。未扣 ECC、備援與壞單元，也不由此推算整顆晶片密度。
knowledge.textEn:
Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Equating stack layers with bits per cell.
Hypothetical inputs and calculation: Assume one NAND string has 64 storage cells, each encoded as TLC with 3 bits: raw capacity is 64×3=192 bits. Two additional select gates are not storage cells. At 2 bits per cell the string has 128 raw bits. ECC, redundancy and bad cells are not deducted, and this does not determine whole-chip density.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直字串」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Vertical strings, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數
把 3D 層數當成單元位元數
只驗第一層就視為整堆疊等效
optionsEn: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell
Equating stack layers with bits per cell
Qualifying an entire stack from the first layer
quiz.explanation: 堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 垂直字串：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Equating stack layers with bits per cell.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「垂直字串」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：選擇閘與儲存單元的功能不同。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Vertical strings artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Equating stack layers with bits per cell". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Select gates differ from storage cells. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數；選擇閘與儲存單元的功能不同。
steps.observationEn: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell; Select gates differ from storage cells.
steps.failure: 若採用「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating stack layers with bits per cell", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「垂直字串」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「選擇閘與儲存單元的功能不同」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Vertical strings, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Select gates differ from storage cells" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 垂直字串／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：選擇閘與儲存單元的功能不同。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Select gates differ from storage cells.

knowledge.title: 垂直字串／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」與「堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Equating stack layers with bits per cell" is not equivalent to "Layer count differs from bits stored per cell"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.failure: 若採用「只驗第一層就視為整堆疊等效」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
